title: Understanding the Problem
text: You have a box with tickets worth $$0$$ and $$3$$ dollars. You draw $$3$$ tickets with replacement. Think about the possible outcomes and their probabilities.

title: Possible Outcomes
text: Consider the possible sums of the values of the tickets you draw. What are the possible sums and how do they relate to the sample mean?

title: Calculating Probabilities
text: Calculate the probability of each possible sample mean. Remember, you are drawing with replacement.

title: Sample Mean Values
text: List the possible values for the sample mean when drawing $$3$$ tickets.

title: Probability of Sample Mean
text: Calculate the probability for each sample mean value: $$0$$, $$1$$, $$2$$, and $$3$$.

title: Plotting the Distribution
text: Use the sample mean values and their probabilities to plot the sampling distribution. Label the axes appropriately.
